remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this should be called, "White Calico Flower." Date 1931."Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Purchased May 2, 1932, with the "Mountains, New Mexico" for  $4,700 for both. See gallery photograph." Pictured in 1931-32 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 51. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
